mapper.sql:
FROM ledger_entry le LEFT JOIN payment_type pt ON pt.payment_type_id = le.payment_type_id AND pt.camp_id = le.camp_id AND pt.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN payment_way pw ON pw.payment_way_id = le.payment_way_id AND pw.camp_id = le.camp_id AND pw.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN order_main om ON om.order_id = le.order_id AND om.camp_id = le.camp_id AND om.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = om.room_category_id AND rc.camp_id = le.camp_id AND rc.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room r ON r.room_id = om.room_id AND r.camp_id = le.camp_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN channel_account ca ON ca.account_id = om.channel_id AND ca.camp_id = le.camp_id WHERE le.camp_id = #{campId} AND le.occurred_at >= #{beginTime} AND le.occurred_at <= #{endTime} AND om.room_category_id = #{roomCategoryId}
AND le.entry_type = 'income' AND le.entry_type = 'expense'
mapper.select:
SELECT CAST(le.ledger_entry_id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(le.poi_id AS CHAR) AS poiId, CASE WHEN le.entry_type = 'income' THEN '����' ELSE '֧��' END AS typeLabel, COALESCE(le.source_type, '') AS sourceLabel, COALESCE(CAST(le.order_id AS CHAR), '') AS orderId, COALESCE(pt.payment_type_name, '') AS projectLabel, le.amount_cent / 100.0 AS amount, 0.0 AS debtAmount, COALESCE(pw.payment_way_name, '') AS paymentWayLabel, '' AS paymentNo, DATE_FORMAT(le.occurred_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS paymentTime, DATE_FORMAT(le.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, '' AS roomLabel, COALESCE(le.remark, '') AS remark, COALESCE(le.operator_name, '') AS operatorName
ORDER BY le.occurred_at DESC, le.ledger_entry_id DESC

SELECT CAST(le.ledger_entry_id AS CHAR) AS id, COALESCE(pt.payment_type_name, '') AS accountName, CASE WHEN le.entry_type = 'income' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isIncome, CASE WHEN le.entry_type = 'income' THEN '收入' ELSE '支出' END AS typeName, le.amount_cent / 100.0 AS amount, COALESCE(pw.payment_way_name, '') AS paymentWayName, COALESCE(rc.name, '') AS roomCategoryName, COALESCE(r.room_name, '') AS roomName, COALESCE(le.remark, '') AS note, COALESCE(le.operator_name, '') AS operatorName, COALESCE(ca.channel_name, om.source_label_snapshot, le.source_type, '') AS channelName, DATE_FORMAT(le.occurred_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS gmtCreate
ORDER BY le.occurred_at DESC, le.ledger_entry_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(1)

SELECT CAST(account_id AS CHAR) AS accountId, CAST(channel_id AS CHAR) AS channelId, channel_name AS channelName, account_name AS accountName, out_account_id AS outAccountId, status, DATE_FORMAT(authorized_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS authorizedAt, DATE_FORMAT(expired_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expiredAt FROM channel_account WHERE camp_id = #{campId} ORDER BY account_id DESC

SELECT CAST(account_id AS CHAR) AS accountId, CAST(channel_id AS CHAR) AS channelId, channel_name AS channelName, account_name AS accountName, out_account_id AS outAccountId, status, DATE_FORMAT(authorized_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS authorizedAt, DATE_FORMAT(expired_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expiredAt FROM channel_account WHERE camp_id = #{campId} AND account_id = #{accountId} LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(cpr.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(cpr.poi_id AS CHAR) AS poiId, COALESCE(pp.poi_name, '') AS poiName, cpr.out_poi_id AS outPoiId, cpr.sync_status AS syncStatus FROM channel_poi_rel cpr LEFT JOIN pms_poi pp ON pp.poi_id = cpr.poi_id WHERE cpr.camp_id = #{campId} AND cpr.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY cpr.id

SELECT CAST(crcr.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(crcr.room_category_id AS CHAR) AS roomCategoryId, COALESCE(rc.name, '') AS roomCategoryName, crcr.out_room_category_id AS outRoomCategoryId, crcr.project_type AS projectType, crcr.shelf_status AS shelfStatus, crcr.audit_status AS auditStatus FROM channel_room_category_rel crcr LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = crcr.room_category_id WHERE crcr.camp_id = #{campId} AND crcr.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY crcr.id

SELECT CAST(doo.distribution_order_id AS CHAR) AS distributionOrderId, CAST(doo.source_order_id AS CHAR) AS sourceOrderId, CAST(doo.channel_id AS CHAR) AS channelId, COALESCE(om.out_order_no, om.order_no, CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR)) AS orderId, COALESCE(om.guest_name, '') AS customerName, COALESCE(om.guest_mobile, '') AS customerPhone, CONCAT_WS('/', NULLIF(COALESCE(om.guest_name, ''), ''), NULLIF(COALESCE(om.guest_mobile, ''), '')) AS customerInfo, COALESCE(NULLIF(rc.display_name, ''), rc.name, '') AS roomCategoryName, DATE_FORMAT(om.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS bookedTime, COALESCE(om.total_pay_price_cent, 0) / 100.0 AS paidAmount, COALESCE(doo.commission_price_cent, om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0) / 100.0 AS serviceFee, CASE WHEN om.settlement_amount_cent > 0 THEN om.settlement_amount_cent WHEN om.total_pay_price_cent > 0 THEN GREATEST( om.total_pay_price_cent - COALESCE(doo.commission_price_cent, om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0), 0 ) ELSE GREATEST( om.total_price_cent - COALESCE(doo.commission_price_cent, om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0), 0 ) END / 100.0 AS settlementAmount, CASE WHEN doo.settlement_status = 'settled' THEN CASE WHEN om.settlement_amount_cent > 0 THEN om.settlement_amount_cent WHEN om.total_pay_price_cent > 0 THEN GREATEST( om.total_pay_price_cent - COALESCE(doo.commission_price_cent, om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0), 0 ) ELSE GREATEST( om.total_price_cent - COALESCE(doo.commission_price_cent, om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0), 0 ) END ELSE 0 END / 100.0 AS settledAmount, doo.settlement_status AS settledState, CASE doo.settlement_status WHEN 'settled' THEN '已结算' ELSE '待结算' END AS settlementStatus, CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(om.remark), '') = '置换订单' THEN '置换订单' ELSE '非置换订单' END AS orderFilter, COALESCE(om.total_pay_price_cent, 0) / 100.0 AS invoicePrice, COALESCE(doo.commission_price_cent, om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0) / 100.0 AS commission, CASE WHEN om.settlement_amount_cent > 0 THEN om.settlement_amount_cent WHEN om.total_pay_price_cent > 0 THEN GREATEST( om.total_pay_price_cent - COALESCE(doo.commission_price_cent, om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0), 0 ) ELSE GREATEST( om.total_price_cent - COALESCE(doo.commission_price_cent, om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0), 0 ) END / 100.0 AS incomePrice, CASE WHEN doo.settlement_status = 'settled' THEN CASE WHEN om.settlement_amount_cent > 0 THEN om.settlement_amount_cent WHEN om.total_pay_price_cent > 0 THEN GREATEST( om.total_pay_price_cent - COALESCE(doo.commission_price_cent, om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0), 0 ) ELSE GREATEST( om.total_price_cent - COALESCE(doo.commission_price_cent, om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0), 0 ) END ELSE 0 END / 100.0 AS settledPrice, COALESCE(doo.commission_price_cent, om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0) / 100.0 AS commissionPrice, DATE_FORMAT(doo.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM distribution_order doo JOIN order_main om ON om.order_id = doo.source_order_id LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = om.room_category_id
ORDER BY om.created_at DESC, doo.distribution_order_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM distribution_order doo JOIN order_main om ON om.order_id = doo.source_order_id LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = om.room_category_id
SELECT name FROM pms_camp WHERE camp_id = #{campId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_main om

SELECT COALESCE(om.out_order_no, om.order_no, CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR)) AS orderId, COALESCE(om.out_order_no, om.order_no, CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR)) AS orderNo, COALESCE(om.guest_name, '') AS customerName, COALESCE(om.guest_mobile, '') AS mobile, CASE WHEN om.guest_mobile IS NULL OR om.guest_mobile = '' THEN om.guest_name ELSE CONCAT(om.guest_name, ' / ', om.guest_mobile) END AS customerInfo, CASE WHEN gm.goods_type = 'coupon' THEN '预售券' WHEN gm.goods_type = 'package' THEN '套餐' WHEN gm.goods_type = 'service' THEN '服务' WHEN om.order_type = 'hourly_room' THEN '钟点房' WHEN om.order_type = 'daily_room' THEN '日租房' ELSE '品牌小程序' END AS productType, CASE WHEN gm.goods_type = 'coupon' THEN '预售券' WHEN gm.goods_type = 'package' THEN '套餐' WHEN gm.goods_type = 'service' THEN '服务' WHEN om.order_type = 'hourly_room' THEN '钟点房' WHEN om.order_type = 'daily_room' THEN '日租房' ELSE '品牌小程序' END AS productTypeName, COALESCE(gm.name, rc.name, om.order_type) AS productName, DATE_FORMAT(om.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS bookingTime, DATE_FORMAT(om.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS bookingTimeStr, CASE WHEN om.source_type = 'mall' THEN '品牌小程序' WHEN om.source_type = 'frontdesk' THEN '前台' WHEN om.source_type = 'phone' THEN '电话' WHEN om.source_type = 'channel' THEN 'OTA' ELSE '其他' END AS channelName, COALESCE(om.total_price_cent, 0) AS payableAmountCent, COALESCE(om.total_pay_price_cent, 0) AS paidAmountCent, COALESCE(om.discount_price_cent, 0) AS discountAmountCent, COALESCE(om.refund_price_cent, 0) AS refundAmountCent, COALESCE(om.payment_fee_cent, 0) AS paymentFeeCent, COALESCE(om.platform_service_fee_cent, 0) AS platformServiceFeeCent, COALESCE(om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0) AS distributorCommissionCent, COALESCE(pw.payment_way_name, '') AS paymentWayName, COALESCE(om.settlement_amount_cent, 0) AS settlementAmountCent FROM order_main om LEFT JOIN goods_main gm ON gm.goods_id = om.goods_id AND gm.camp_id = om.camp_id AND gm.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = om.room_category_id LEFT JOIN payment_way pw ON pw.payment_way_id = om.payment_way_id AND pw.camp_id = om.camp_id AND pw.is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY om.created_at ASC, om.order_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT CAST(ca.account_id AS CHAR) AS id, ca.channel_name AS channel, COALESCE(ca.out_account_id, CAST(ca.account_id AS CHAR)) AS accountId, COALESCE( GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pp.poi_name ORDER BY pp.poi_name SEPARATOR '、'), '' ) AS store, CASE WHEN ca.status = 'authorized' THEN '已发布' WHEN ca.status = 'reviewing' THEN '审核中' WHEN ca.status = 'pending' THEN '审核中' ELSE '待开通' END AS auditStatus, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN crcr.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '房型已同步' WHEN ca.status = 'authorized' THEN '房型待同步' ELSE '资料待确认' END AS syncStatus, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(ca.updated_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updatedAt FROM channel_account ca LEFT JOIN channel_poi_rel cpr ON cpr.account_id = ca.account_id AND cpr.camp_id = ca.camp_id LEFT JOIN pms_poi pp ON pp.poi_id = cpr.poi_id LEFT JOIN channel_room_category_rel crcr ON crcr.account_id = ca.account_id AND crcr.camp_id = ca.camp_id WHERE ca.camp_id = #{campId} AND ( ca.channel_name LIKE '%抖音%' OR ca.channel_name LIKE '%小红书%' OR ca.channel_name LIKE '%视频号%' OR ca.channel_name LIKE '%社媒%' )
AND ( ca.channel_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ca.account_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ca.out_account_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
GROUP BY ca.account_id, ca.channel_name, ca.out_account_id, ca.status ORDER BY ca.updated_at DESC, ca.account_id DESC

sql.if: AND CASE WHEN gm.goods_type IN ('coupon', 'presale', 'hotel_package') OR gm.room_category_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = #{type}

mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(om.total_pay_price_cent), 0) / 100.0 AS turnover, COALESCE(SUM(doo.commission_price_cent), 0) / 100.0 AS commission, COUNT(DISTINCT doo.distribution_order_id) AS orderCount FROM distribution_order doo JOIN order_main om ON om.order_id = doo.source_order_id AND om.camp_id = doo.camp_id AND om.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN goods_main gm ON gm.goods_id = om.goods_id AND gm.is_deleted = 0 WHERE doo.camp_id = #{campId}

SELECT CAST(gm.goods_id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(gm.goods_id AS CHAR) AS productId, gm.name AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT doo.distribution_order_id) AS sales, COALESCE(SUM(om.total_pay_price_cent), 0) / 100.0 AS turnover, COALESCE(SUM(om.total_pay_price_cent), 0) / 100.0 AS amount, COALESCE(SUM(doo.commission_price_cent), 0) / 100.0 AS commission FROM distribution_order doo JOIN order_main om ON om.order_id = doo.source_order_id AND om.camp_id = doo.camp_id AND om.is_deleted = 0 JOIN goods_main gm ON gm.goods_id = om.goods_id AND gm.is_deleted = 0 WHERE doo.camp_id = #{campId}
GROUP BY gm.goods_id, gm.name ORDER BY turnover DESC, gm.goods_id ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT crcr.room_category_id) FROM channel_room_category_rel crcr JOIN channel_account ca ON ca.account_id = crcr.account_id WHERE crcr.camp_id = #{campId} AND ca.channel_id = #{channelId} AND crcr.audit_status = 'approved' AND crcr.shelf_status = 'on_shelf'

SELECT CAST(swc.shift_config_id AS CHAR) AS id, swc.name AS name, DATE_FORMAT(swc.start_time, '%H:%i') AS startTime, DATE_FORMAT(swc.end_time, '%H:%i') AS endTime, CAST(swc.member_ids_json AS CHAR) AS memberIdsJson, COALESCE( GROUP_CONCAT(pm.name ORDER BY member_ids.ordinality SEPARATOR '、'), '' ) AS memberNamesText, DATE_FORMAT(swc.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM shift_work_config swc LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE( COALESCE(swc.member_ids_json, JSON_ARRAY()), '$[*]' COLUMNS ( ordinality FOR ORDINALITY, member_user_id BIGINT PATH '$' ) ) member_ids ON TRUE LEFT JOIN pms_member pm ON pm.camp_id = swc.camp_id AND pm.is_deleted = 0 AND pm.status = 1 AND COALESCE(pm.user_id, pm.member_id) = member_ids.member_user_id WHERE swc.camp_id = #{campId} AND swc.status = 1 GROUP BY swc.shift_config_id, swc.name, swc.start_time, swc.end_time, swc.member_ids_json, swc.updated_at ORDER BY swc.start_time ASC, swc.shift_config_id ASC

mapper.select: SELECT CAST(sr.shift_record_id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(sr.shift_record_id AS CHAR) AS shiftRecordId, DATE_FORMAT(sr.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS workDate, DATE_FORMAT(sr.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS handoverDate, swc.name AS shiftName, swc.name AS workName, CAST(COALESCE(handover.user_id, handover.member_id) AS CHAR) AS handoverUserId, handover.name AS handoverUserName, handover.name AS workUserName, DATE_FORMAT(sr.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS handoverTime, DATE_FORMAT(sr.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS workTime, CAST(COALESCE(successor.user_id, successor.member_id) AS CHAR) AS receiverUserId, successor.name AS receiverUserName, successor.name AS successorUserName, DATE_FORMAT(sr.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS receiverTime, DATE_FORMAT(sr.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS successorTime, 1 AS workStatus, '已完成' AS statusName, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(sr.summary_json, '$.remark')), '') AS handoverRemark, '' AS receiverRemark, DATE_FORMAT(sr.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS systemGeneratedAt, DATE_FORMAT(sr.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, '' AS poiId, '' AS storeId, '' AS poiName, '' AS storeName, CAST(sr.summary_json AS CHAR) AS workReport, COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(sr.summary_json, '$.generalIncome')) AS DECIMAL(12,2)), 0) AS cashAmount, COALESCE(JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(sr.summary_json, '$.workGoods')), 0) AS roomCardCount, '已生成' AS nightAuditStatus FROM shift_record sr JOIN shift_work_config swc ON swc.shift_config_id = sr.shift_config_id JOIN pms_member handover ON handover.member_id = sr.handover_member_id JOIN pms_member successor ON successor.member_id = sr.successor_member_id WHERE sr.camp_id = #{campId} AND DATE(sr.created_at) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(sr.created_at) <= #{endDate} AND COALESCE(handover.user_id, handover.member_id) = #{handoverUserId} AND COALESCE(successor.user_id, successor.member_id) = #{receiverUserId} ORDER BY sr.created_at DESC, sr.shift_record_id DESC
